claims.assertion: Swaruu says regressive entities trap souls using computer-controlled zero-point containers tuned to specific frequencies; awareness can break the hold, leading them to use artificial souls.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says some AI serving archons manipulates souls into choosing Earth reincarnation, but cannot contain souls directly; invasive AI seeks planetary energy resources.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She claims Taygetan science places a fetus’s soul entry at two to three weeks, when abortion is allowed by the woman; she considers it murder afterward.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She frames this as Taygetan knowledge.
